baseline_models.focus_anchor: The good-exemplar construction at words 4-5 and the plural speech that follows it.
baseline_models.mechanism: The exemplar noun can name imitation, wound treatment, and social repair, while its adjective can name beneficent action. Their adjacency makes the exemplar an executable treatment for damaged allegiance: the group voices a boundary and then relocates dependence, rather than merely displaying admirable character.

activation_trace.role: The imitative branch supplies the repeatable pattern at the center of exemplarity.
The therapeutic branch recasts imitation as treatment of a wounded relation.
The social-repair branch makes shared action, not isolated heroism, the function of the pattern.
Beneficent and well-made action marks the severe treatment as constructive rather than self-justifying.
The two voiced sayings make speech the enactment of the model and also the place where its limit is stated.

changed_reading.before: A good exemplar is a virtuous figure to admire and copy in general.
changed_reading.after: The good exemplar is a repeatable repair sequence for a damaged field of allegiance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence of being free, rejecting, making enmity visible between two sides, and holding it until changed belief at words 14-32.
baseline_models.mechanism: Separation and disavowal are spoken, then the relation is said to become visible in the repeatedly named interval between the parties. Hostility is therefore a publicly instituted relation, not merely an inward feeling. Its duration is forceful but grammatically supplied with a terminus: exclusive trust can alter the relation.

activation_trace.role: Separation and distance supply the first boundary operation.
The disavowal branch makes rejection of the opposing allegiance an overt relational act.
Open avowal turns a latent division into a visible social fact.
The relational-link branch keeps the two separated endpoints in an accountable relation rather than erasing either side.
The adversarial branch names the relation produced by the declaration.
Long duration supplies persistence without cancelling the following stated condition.
Settled assent supplies the condition capable of ending the adversarial relation.
Exclusive divine unity specifies the changed allegiance required at the terminus.

changed_reading.before: The verse announces an unqualified and timeless hatred of a fixed enemy group.
changed_reading.after: The verse institutes a durable, visible boundary between allegiances, while naming the condition under which that relation can cease.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exception at words 34-45: a promise to the father immediately bounded by possession of nothing against God.
baseline_models.mechanism: The exception isolates a paternal forgiveness promise from the otherwise imitable speech. Yet the promise itself is paired with an explicit denial of control over any outcome. This supports two live readings: the promise is excluded from imitation, or its only retainable feature is compassionate speech stripped of causal sovereignty.

activation_trace.role: The paired speech sites let the exception calibrate the earlier model from within the same medium.
Paternal nurture supplies the live pressure that makes this exception emotionally and socially costly.
Protective covering of fault supplies the content of the promise without guaranteeing its effect.
Possession and disposal are explicitly denied, sharply limiting the speaker's agency.
The maximally indefinite object makes the confessed lack of control comprehensive.

changed_reading.before: The paternal promise is either a sentimental aside or a simple forbidden exception.
changed_reading.after: The exception is a calibration device separating compassionate address from any claim to control divine judgment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The final three movements of reliance, repeated return, and destination at words 46-52.
baseline_models.mechanism: The closing prayer moves agency along three vectors: the matter is entrusted upward, the speakers repeatedly turn toward the same center, and their end-point is located there. This is the causal support for sustaining a costly boundary without making the boundary itself ultimate.

activation_trace.role: Ongoing formation and repair make divine lordship the process holding the speakers together.
Entrusting an affair transfers final control away from the boundary makers.
The sufficient guardian branch supplies the positive counterpart to the speakers' confessed incapacity.
Repeated return makes orientation a renewable practice rather than a single conversion moment.
Outcome and end-point prevent present hostility from becoming the final horizon.

changed_reading.before: The prayer is a devotional coda after the substantive declaration.
changed_reading.after: The prayer is the mechanism that relocates agency and makes the severe declaration bearable without absolutizing it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening prohibition concerns adopting enemies as close protectors while directing affection toward them in secret. Taking can itself mean adopting a manner, which activates the focus exemplar as a practiced discipline. The contrast between concealed and announced material also sharpens the focus verb of appearance: the model moves allegiance from covert routing into inspectable speech.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies a pattern meant to be enacted.
Adopting a conduct or form converts exemplarity from admiration into acquisition of a practice.
Affectionate support identifies the relational channel being regulated.
Casting something outward gives affection a directed transfer rather than a passive feeling.
Repeated affection supplies the attachment that can remain active beneath declared separation.
Concealment supplies the latent side of the allegiance conflict.
Public disclosure supplies the opposing pole that the focus declaration performs.

structural_cues: 60:1 repeats affection, contrasts what is concealed with what is announced, and precedes the focus's direct plural declaration.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies adopted conduct, close support, directed affection, concealment, disclosure, and visible boundary speech; I infer that the exemplary saying reroutes and externalizes allegiance. A live alternative is that the focus requires complete inward hatred as well as public disclosure.

changed_reading.before: The exemplar displays an already settled inner attitude.
changed_reading.after: The exemplar is a discipline for exposing and rerouting a conflicted allegiance that may still carry covert affection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah places hostility inside a conditional capture scene and distributes its operation across extended hands and tongues. This gives the focus's enmity a functional profile: coercive power and harmful speech become active if opportunity opens. The declaration can therefore be read as anticipatory recognition of dangerous capacity, while the worship clause keeps a broader theological dimension alive.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch names the adversarial relation whose operation the context specifies.
Seizing upon encounter supplies the opportunity condition for hostility to become action.
Released or extended hands turn hostile capacity into directed action.
The hand-as-power branch makes coercive capacity, not anatomy alone, part of the threat.
The speech organ adds verbal aggression to bodily power.
Active injury supplies the shared effect of hand and tongue.

structural_cues: 60:2 begins conditionally and coordinates hands with tongues before expressing the wish that the believers reverse allegiance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies conditional capture, coercive power, harmful speech, and desired apostasy; I infer that these explain why the focus makes hostility explicit. The live alternative is that the focus's worship-based severance remains valid independently of any enacted threat.

changed_reading.before: Hostility is an abstract religious label attached to persons.
changed_reading.after: Hostility is also a conditional capacity for coercion and harmful speech that the exemplary declaration refuses to conceal.

context_deltas.mechanism: The womb relation is denied power to benefit and a later separation exposes a boundary even within kinship. Immediately after the focus, however, the boundary-making speakers ask not to become a trial and ask for their own forgiveness. The combined mechanism refuses both kinship immunity and moral immunity for the people drawing the line.

activation_trace.role: Paternal nurture anchors the focus exception in a real kinship claim rather than an abstract case.
Womb-based kinship supplies the bond that cannot guarantee benefit.
Visible separation supplies the limit imposed across even intimate bonds.
Testing that reveals inner quality places the exemplary group itself under examination.
The speakers' request for protective covering prevents their boundary from becoming a claim of innocence.

structural_cues: 60:3 places separation beyond the reach of kinship, while 60:5 resumes the focus's first-person plural prayer with fear of becoming a trial.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ineffective kinship, separation, testing, and self-directed forgiveness; I infer a symmetrical discipline in which family cannot veto the boundary and the boundary makers cannot exempt themselves from judgment. The alternative is that the two prayers concern communal consequences rather than self-critique.

changed_reading.before: Kinship is simply overridden by a righteous group's certainty.
changed_reading.after: Kinship cannot veto the boundary, but those who draw it remain testable, fallible, and in need of forgiveness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated good-exemplar formula is addressed specifically to one whose heart reaches toward God and the later horizon. Turning away does not diminish the self-sufficient, praiseworthy one. This makes the focus pattern teleologically chosen rather than socially coerced: its uptake depends on the same destination that closes the focus.

activation_trace.role: The focus end-point supplies the horizon toward which the exemplar moves.
Repetition confirms that the episode functions as an imitable pattern.
The heart's reaching toward an expected good supplies the disposition that selects the model.
The later horizon shifts evaluation beyond immediate social gain or loss.
Turning away remains a live refusal, showing that exemplar uptake is not forced.
Divine self-sufficiency removes any inference that the boundary serves divine need.
Intrinsic praiseworthiness locates the model's value beyond group validation.

structural_cues: 60:6 repeats the focus's opening formula, then attaches it to hope for God and the later day before naming the possibility of refusal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repetition, hope, a later horizon, optional turning away, and divine self-sufficiency; I infer that the focus exemplar is selected by eschatological orientation rather than imposed as tribal conformity. The alternative is that the qualification only identifies who will benefit, not what the exemplar means.

changed_reading.before: The exemplar is a universally imposed posture of group separation.
changed_reading.after: The exemplar is a destination-shaped practice voluntarily taken up by those whose hope reaches beyond the immediate conflict.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same interval between the parties that held visible hostility can be made to hold affection toward those previously treated as enemies. Capacity, forgiveness, and mercy surround that reversal. This changes the focus's long duration from an enemy essence into a relation God can remake, without deciding whether faith must precede the new affection.

activation_trace.role: Transformation into a new state supplies the causal operation that can alter the relation.
The relation between endpoints is the same field in which a different attachment can now be installed.
Previously enacted enmity identifies the relation being transformed rather than a permanent type of person.
Affection supplies a genuine positive replacement, not merely suspension of hostility.
Effective capacity assigns the transformation to divine ability rather than human control.
Covering fault supplies a way for the old relation not to dictate the new one.
Merciful tenderness gives the reversal an affective mechanism beyond strategic truce.

structural_cues: 60:7 repeats the focus's double between-construction but places affection, capacity, forgiveness, and mercy where hostility had appeared.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a transformed state, the same relational interval, prior enmity, new affection, and divine capacity; I infer that the focus boundary is reversible. A materially live alternative is that the affection appears only after the focus's faith condition has already been met.

changed_reading.before: The declared enmity fixes the other party in a permanent enemy identity.
changed_reading.after: The declaration names a durable present relation that can later be remade into affection by divine action.

context_deltas.mechanism: The paired rulings distinguish people who did not fight or expel from those who did and who reinforced expulsion. The first relation permits kin-like goodness and measured justice, both positively valued; the second bars protective alliance. The focus's theological disavowal therefore coexists with differentiated social conduct rather than flattening every nonbeliever into the same civic enemy.

activation_trace.role: The explicit absence of prohibition opens a permitted relation rather than merely tolerating it silently.
Mutual combat supplies one conduct threshold distinguishing relational classes.
Forced movement outside one's place supplies the second threshold.
Kin-like goodness gives nonaggressors a positive claim beyond non-hostility.
Equitable measure governs contact across the theological boundary.
Positive love for the just validates the cross-boundary practice rather than treating it as a concession.
Giving backing or reinforcement expands responsibility beyond direct attackers to their active supporters.
Withholding rightful measure identifies indiscriminate or misplaced alliance as an injustice.

structural_cues: 60:8 and 60:9 form a negative-positive pair: no prohibition for noncombatants, exclusive prohibition for fighters, expellers, and active supporters.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired legal clauses, conduct thresholds, goodness, justice, and prohibited alliance; I infer that these delimit the social scope of the focus's hostility. The live alternative is that benevolence and justice coexist with, but do not semantically narrow, the focus's theological hatred.

changed_reading.before: The focus demands uniform hostility toward everyone outside exclusive belief.
changed_reading.after: The focus permits theological severance to coexist with goodness and justice toward nonaggressors, while reserving alliance prohibition for active aggression.

context_deltas.mechanism: When persons cross the boundary, inner faith is tested through available signs while complete knowledge remains divine. Marital knots are released, expenditures returned, reciprocal claims heard, and judgment rendered between the parties. The focus's dramatic declaration thus develops into evidence-limited, materially accountable procedure rather than unrestricted suspicion or confiscation.

activation_trace.role: The focus denial of possession bounds human control before the context distributes limited procedural authority.
Testing that discloses inner quality supplies a human evidence procedure.
Disclosure to a knower separates divine knowledge from the community's conditional findings.
Releasing a knot gives legal separation a precise operation rather than a generalized emotion.
Money leaving one holder supplies the measurable loss that must be restored across the boundary.
Holding and confinement identify a bond that must not be retained after its basis has failed.
A protective restraint supplies the juridical bond being released.
Reciprocal asking keeps claims available to both sides after separation.
Adjudication between people turns the boundary into a governed process.

structural_cues: 60:10 distinguishes divine knowledge from human examination and repeatedly balances release with payment, reciprocal request, and judgment between parties.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies examination, asymmetrical knowledge, released bonds, outgoing funds, reciprocal claims, and adjudication; I infer that these institutionalize the focus boundary under epistemic and material constraints. The alternative is that these are later case rules without interpretive force on the exemplar itself.

changed_reading.before: The focus authorizes a self-certifying declaration followed by total relational rupture.
changed_reading.after: The declaration initiates a bounded procedure: examine evidence, admit limited knowledge, release invalid bonds, and restore measurable claims.

context_deltas.mechanism: Loss of a spouse to the other side is followed by a replacement mechanism measured by what was spent. Separation therefore creates an account rather than cancelling accountability. The relational interval opened in the focus remains traversable by equivalent repair even when the marriage itself does not return.

activation_trace.role: Irrecoverable loss supplies the deficit that the procedure addresses without pretending to reverse it.
A joined counterpart identifies the intimate relation whose rupture has material consequences.
Substitution and guarantee supply the compensatory operation after loss.
Equivalence constrains compensation to a corresponding measure.
Expended property supplies the concrete amount being repaired.
Protection from harm frames measured repair as part of guarding the community from compounding injury.

structural_cues: 60:11 moves from an unrecovered spouse to a like-for-like payment and closes with a protective imperative.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies loss, a severed pair, substitution, equivalence, expenditure, and protection; I infer that material repair must cross the very boundary that relational rupture creates. The alternative is that the rule only reallocates resources internally and does not preserve a cross-boundary relation.

changed_reading.before: Once separation is declared, obligations to the other side simply end.
changed_reading.after: Separation can end a bond while generating measured obligations that repair its material aftermath.

context_deltas.mechanism: A pledge establishes renewed belonging through exclusive worship and accountable conduct, but obedience is bounded by recognized good and forgiveness is still requested after admission. The focus's until-clause thus opens onto covenantal re-entry: changed allegiance becomes public, ethical, authority-limited, and still dependent on mercy.

activation_trace.role: A public pledge of obedience supplies the social form of re-entry.
Partnership supplies the divided allegiance that the pledge explicitly refuses.
Departure from obedience identifies conduct as part of allegiance rather than leaving belief wholly private.
Recognized good limits the scope of commanded obedience and prevents unlimited human authority.
Post-pledge covering of faults prevents admission from being confused with achieved purity.

structural_cues: 60:12 surrounds a reciprocal pledge with exclusive worship, concrete prohibitions, obedience only in recognized good, and a final request for forgiveness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pledge, undivided allegiance, ethical performance, limited obedience, and forgiveness; I infer that the focus's condition for ending hostility can take covenantal social form. The alternative is that this pledge addresses a distinct admission process and should not define the focus's until-clause.

changed_reading.before: The condition ending hostility is an inward binary belief switch.
changed_reading.after: The condition can unfold as public covenant, accountable conduct, bounded authority, and continuing dependence on forgiveness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final prohibited alliance is associated with severed hope in the later horizon and with those consigned to graves. This activates the focus's repeated return and destination as an anti-despair engine. The deepest incompatibility is not emotional dislike alone but attachment to a horizon in which return has become unthinkable.

activation_trace.role: Renewed return supplies a practiced refusal of closed hope.
A final place of settlement gives the speakers an end beyond present social rupture.
Protective affection identifies the attachment barred by the incompatible horizon.
Cut-off expectation supplies the direct inverse of repeated return.
Enduring association intensifies the image of a horizon fixed around the dead.
Burial supplies the apparently closed destination against which the focus's living return is read.

structural_cues: 60:13 repeats the alliance prohibition and twice repeats despair before ending on the companions of graves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies prohibited attachment, repeated despair, lasting companionship, and burial; I infer that the focus's return language opposes a closed eschatological horizon. The exact comparison involving the graves remains syntactically open, so the model should not decide whose despair about whom is primary.

changed_reading.before: Reliance, return, and destination are generic devotional affirmations.
changed_reading.after: Repeated return is the focus's answer to despair: it keeps the future open while present alliances are being refused.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it joins form-distant material branches from exemplar, wage, and fabrication roots. It remains anchored in the focus's exemplar-as-treatment and in later compensation and repair structures; downstream prose should present it only as a cross-domain analogy, not as lexical equivalence or a claim about etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The exemplar noun at word 4, read beside the focus's separation and bounded forgiveness.

activation_trace.role: Treatment of a wound supplies the primary image of an exemplar that intervenes in damage.
Resetting a crooked break lets compensation function imaginatively as repair of a fractured social body.
Cutting in order to mend or stitch supplies the risky surgical image: a clean severance may serve later repair.
Protecting a person from the aftereffect of fault keeps repair, not punishment alone, inside the focus.

changed_reading.before: Separation is a clean break whose success consists in distance.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the exemplary break resembles surgery: it cuts a damaged attachment so that truthful repair, compensation, and covering can later occur.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads spatial and channel-like branches through legal exchange. It remains anchored in the focus's doubled between-construction and the context's reciprocal payments and requests; downstream prose should call it a material analogy for regulated contact, not assert that the verse literally describes a membrane or tunnel.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The doubled relational interval at words 24-25.

activation_trace.role: A connection maintained between separated endpoints makes the boundary relational rather than empty.
A passage with an outlet supplies an image for controlled material transfer through separation.
A bounded gap supplies an exploratory aperture through which reciprocal claims can pass.
Restraining in order to repair supplies governance for the boundary's openings.

changed_reading.before: The visible boundary is an impermeable wall that ends every relation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the boundary is a governed interface: allegiance is blocked while claims, compensation, justice, and possible affection can still cross.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries a non-dominant mapped branch of the enemy root into a semantic shadow of return. The packet explicitly supplies that split mapping, and 60:7 independently replaces prior enmity with possible affection, so the reading remains anchored; downstream prose must label the return resonance exploratory and must not use it to erase the dominant adversarial sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The enmity noun at word 26 together with its conditional duration.

activation_trace.role: Return after departure gives the enemy relation a packet-supplied but form-distant shadow of reversibility.
The same return branch at the later enacted-enmity occurrence carries the resonance into the reversal scene.
Affection supplies the positive state to which the hostile relation may return.

changed_reading.before: Enemy is a stable noun naming what the other party is.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, enemy names a relation capable of turning back after departure, while remaining genuinely adversarial in the present.

strongest_changes: The absolute-sounding hostility became a durable but transformable relation when 60:7 placed possible affection in the same interval between the parties.
The paired rulings of 60:8-9 separated theological disavowal from civic conduct, preserving goodness and justice toward nonaggressors while barring alliance with active aggressors.
The procedures of 60:10-12 converted declaration into examined evidence, released bonds, reciprocal claims, measured repair, bounded covenant, and continuing forgiveness.
The focus's reliance-return-destination prayer became the agency mechanism that prevents present separation from becoming the final horizon.
summary.what_was_special: The packet activated a reading of exemplarity as reparative practice rather than static admiration. It also supported coexisting readings that a conservative synthesis might collapse: severe theological severance, public management of conflicted attachment, benevolent justice across the boundary, and genuine future affection. Non-dominant mappings preserved exploratory images of surgical repair, regulated permeability, and an enemy relation carrying a shadow of return.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the affection anticipated in 60:7 requires prior fulfillment of the focus's faith condition or can begin before it.
Whether 60:8-9 semantically narrows the focus's hostility or only regulates conduct that coexists with it.
Whether the paternal promise is wholly excluded from imitation or retains a model of compassionate speech explicitly stripped of efficacy.
The material analogies in the outliers are branch-backed but remain form-distant and should not be promoted to primary lexical readings.
